newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank "relaxed" about talk of mergers.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank "relaxed" about talk of mergers.

text.p: Commerzbank chief executive Martin Kohlhaussen said on Tuesday his bank was "relaxed" about the current discussion about bank mergers in Germany.
"We are watching discussions with interest, but in a relaxed way," Kohlhaussen said in the text of a speech prepared for delivery at a news conference to announce the bank's nine-month figures.
"This bank is strong, but well-equipped -- materially, mentally and professionally -- to go its own way as it has done for the last 126 years," Kohlhaussen said.
A precondition for the successful survival in the banking market of the future was a healthy foundation which would be strenghtened by this year's results, Kohlhaussen said.
Innovation and flexibility were further preconditions for independance, he said.
